source.ref: XG: '我们不能用toast, 我们直接 streaming response ... 做完后显示 Conversation above has been summarized... 因为我们是针对当前session 做的 你不能用toast'

acceptance.given: a context_compacted SSE event arrives for the active tab
acceptance.then: a role=system message with COMPACT_NOTICE_TEXT is appended to that tab's MessageStore and stays in the stream (no auto-dismiss)

acceptance.given: a context_compacted event for a non-active tab

requirements.statement: Preserve the existing context_warning-clearing side effect on compact; keep MessageStore single-writer + per-tab isolation; no last-write-wins race.

clarifications.question: 持久化范围:只 session 内留痕(store append,刷新/冷启动后消失),还是也要后端 DB 持久化(冷启动重载后仍可见,像 resume_boundary)?
options: A. session-scoped frontend-only (store append, no DB row) — 像 refresh- 分隔线
B. backend-persisted DB row — 像 resume_boundary,冷启动后仍在
clarifications.answer: A. session-scoped frontend-only (store append, no DB row)
clarifications.resolution: XG said '针对当前 session 做的' — compaction 是当前 session 的上下文事件,session-scoped 留痕即满足'做完后在对话流里显示、可回看'的诉求。后端 compaction 本就不持久化(session_unit.py 只发 SSE),加 DB 持久化是更大改动(backend+migration+reconcile survival)且 XG 未要求。先做 A(THINK 会复核);若后续要冷启动可见再加 B。
